controlApplicability.standard: Standard — Stable Release Security Blockers v1.0

controls.title: No Exposed Secrets
controls.justification: Complete-history Gitleaks records 0 unreviewed findings; exact published artifact secret scanning reported no leaks.

controls.title: Repository and Git History Are Clean
controls.justification: The accepted Stable Security evidence scanned the complete fetched Git history and retained the exact reviewed false-positive fingerprint set.

controls.title: Public Keys and Public Client Credentials Are Actually Public-Safe
controls.justification: The shared-library artifact ships no authentication credential, service credential, signing key, API secret, or public-client credential boundary.

controls.title: Secret Lifecycle Is Enforceable
controls.justification: GLAZE UI owns no runtime secret lifecycle; repository/release credentials are platform-managed and not embedded in the artifact.

controls.title: Resource-Level Authorization
controls.justification: The shared presentation library owns no resource service, database, account resource, or authorization enforcement boundary.

controls.title: Sensitive Data Protection
controls.justification: The library owns no user dataset, persistent storage, protected-data-at-rest boundary, or independent network transport.

controls.title: No Protected-Data Leakage
controls.justification: The library owns no protected dataset, backend log pipeline, export endpoint, or analytics transport; downstream hosts retain their data-leakage controls.

controls.title: Tenant and User Isolation
controls.justification: The shared runtime has no tenant/user datastore or server-side multi-user access path.

controls.title: Server-Side Authentication
controls.justification: There is no server, login endpoint, credential verifier, or authenticated resource boundary in this component.

controls.title: Ownership and Authorization Checks
controls.justification: The library performs no privileged read/write/delete/share/export operation against owned resources.

controls.title: Protected Fields Cannot Be Tampered With
controls.justification: The library owns no protected server-side role, tenant, billing, identity, or authorization fields.

controls.title: Privilege Is Least-Authority
controls.justification: The library has no role/privilege system or privileged runtime authority; operational authority remains caller-owned.

controls.title: Sessions Are Secure
controls.justification: The library creates and manages no sessions, cookies, refresh tokens, or server authentication state.

controls.title: Password Handling Is Approved
controls.justification: The artifact performs no password collection, hashing, verification, storage, or recovery.

controls.title: Sensitive Endpoints Are Rate-Limited
controls.justification: The component exposes no network endpoint.

controls.title: Public Abuse Paths Are Protected
controls.justification: There is no independently hosted public API/service abuse boundary in the shared library.

controls.title: Queries Are Parameterized
controls.justification: The component performs no database or server-side query construction.

controls.title: Input Is Validated Server-Side
controls.justification: There is no server-side request-processing boundary; consumer applications retain server-side validation responsibilities.

controls.title: User Content Is Safely Rendered
controls.justification: Qualified presentation evidence and exact-artifact review establish the shared rendering boundary without direct dynamic-code authority; downstream applications remain responsible for their own user-content sanitization and rendering.

controls.title: Server-Side Request and Redirect Safety
controls.justification: The library has no server-side request, proxy, redirect, or SSRF boundary.

controls.title: File Uploads Are Restricted
controls.justification: The library implements no upload endpoint, attachment store, or owned file-ingestion boundary.

controls.title: API Responses Are Minimized
controls.justification: The component exposes no HTTP/API response surface.

controls.title: Security Headers Are Configured
controls.justification: HTTP response headers are controlled by downstream host applications/services, not this source-distributed shared library.

controls.title: HTTPS Is Enforced
controls.justification: The library owns no listener, origin, TLS termination, or production transport endpoint.

controls.title: CORS Is Explicit
controls.justification: The library owns no HTTP server/API CORS boundary.

controls.title: CSRF Protection Is Appropriate to the Authentication Model
controls.justification: The component has no automatically attached credential model or state-changing HTTP endpoint.

controls.title: Dependencies Are Scanned
controls.justification: The selected Android/Wear build-tool graph contains 206 selected coordinates / 426 package entries with 0 OSV advisories and a 206-component CycloneDX SBOM with 0 vulnerabilities; released runtime external dependency count is 0.

controls.title: Dependency State Is Reproducible
controls.justification: Selected Gradle dependency evidence is exact-version governed; final release artifact preparation used deterministic double-build equality and the published runtime has zero external runtime dependencies.

controls.title: Artifact and Source Provenance Is Traceable
controls.justification: Provenance binds exact accepted source/tree to release archive, SBOM, builder identity, ruleset, tag, and post-publication digest readback.

controls.title: Build and CI Credentials Are Protected
controls.justification: Security/artifact preparation workflows use read-only repository permissions; publication write authority is isolated to the protected post-merge publication workflow and is unavailable on pull requests.

controls.title: Exact-Revision Validation
controls.justification: Qualification, security, artifact preparation, publication, and byte-readback evidence are bound to exact accepted source a7180679ea851389e0f3004515f9a25f420e716d and controlled publication commit 7e8b537b9d1a123bc3e92679774a4d9cc704e03b.

controls.title: Validation Fails Closed
controls.justification: Required checks reject missing/mismatched exact-head, scanner, checksum/SBOM/provenance, branch-protection, publication, and lifecycle evidence.

controls.title: Production Debug Behavior Is Disabled
controls.justification: The accepted source/runtime artifact is presentation-only, contains no production service/debug endpoint or authority bypass, and qualified validation preserves non-authorizing behavior.

controls.title: Artifact Matches Reviewed Source
controls.justification: Deterministic provenance and source manifest bind the accepted archive to the exact reviewed source/tree; publication reused the accepted bytes and post-publication readback matched them byte-for-byte.

controls.title: Security Gates Cannot Be Silently Bypassed
controls.justification: Active ruleset 23699829 requires governed checks on protected main, blocks force pushes/deletion, has no bypass actors, and reports current_user_can_bypass=never.

controls.title: Logging and Auditability
controls.justification: The stateless library owns no independent production security log; repository, CI, release, and acceptance actions are auditable through GitHub and governed records.

controls.title: Safe Failure
controls.justification: The 24/24 qualification, resilience/feedback, authority-boundary, accessibility, and fail-closed release controls establish safe failure for the shared presentation boundary; downstream operational failure handling remains consumer-local.

controls.title: Security Monitoring and Detection
controls.justification: The library operates no independent production service or monitoring backend; downstream hosts own runtime monitoring/detection.

controls.title: Recovery Preserves Security
controls.justification: Known-good rollback remains V1.5.1 with retained source/runtime/acceptance provenance; no mutable user/security data migration is owned by this shared library.
